question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 9.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'tense.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 tension
 a feeling of nervousness before an important or difficult event
 
 

 tensioned
 wrong from of tension
 
 

 tense
 nervous and worried and unable to relax
 
 

 intense
 extreme and forceful or (of a feeling) very strong
 
 
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the author experienced a bad ride but he did not notice it because his mental condition was very nervous due to some other concerns.

 
 
• Here we have to use the adjective form** 'tense'** to describe the mental condition of the author.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "tense."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

​

Complete passage:__ *The rain was coming down relentlessly. Even __(1) with__ a fast windscreen wiper, the road was __(2) hardly__ visible in the dark. Away from the noisy station we had just left, I __(3) noticed__ the empty roads. Indeed, who would be walking __(4) about__ at such a late hour in the pouring rain? Shekhar was __(5) a__ steady driver as a rule, but we __(6) were__ both worried by now and he was already driving __(7) extremely__ fast. The road conditions were __(8) far__ from good. It was a bad ride, but we barely noticed it as we were so __(9) tense__. The only thing I was worried about was finding my daughter, a young, __(10) unaccompanied__ girl alone on the streets at this hour.*
